title: Corrected exact-grid CFR resolution profile
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: On the 128GB host, increasing abstraction from the validated 2-bucket smoke to at least 8 buckets is tractable with a larger V8 heap, and heldout strategy drift across iteration checkpoints can identify a minimum useful solve budget before multi-board scaling.
material_change: Add non-destructive per-run output directories; solve the same corrected 200bb exact-grid SRP/3BP flop at increasing buckets and iterations, recording wall time, memory boundary, info sets, and strategy drift rather than training from an unconverged teacher.
baseline: Corrected one-flop 2-bucket 10-iteration smoke: SRP 783,584 info sets in 8.7s; 3BP 139,380 in 1.4s; exact financial parity.

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: 8-bucket/10-iteration corrected SRP solve completed with a 24GB V8 heap: 2,230,802 info sets, 9.3s solve, 121.7MB JSONL. The prior default-heap OOM was a runtime limit, not host capacity.

Seed plumbing made key coverage prefix-deterministic. At b8/i200 the solve reached 13,914,074 infosets, 7.98GB peak heap and 228.5s traversal (336.2s including 762MB export), yet root/depth1 drift from i50 remained 0.239/0.189 TV. Map-based full-tree CFR is not converged or scalable enough for multi-board production.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: Profiled corrected exact-grid tabular CFR through 8 buckets and 200 seeded iterations and made its learning curve reproducible.
result.conclusion: The host can run b8/i200, but one SRP flop already consumes 13.9M infosets, 8.0GB heap, 228.5s solve and a 762MB export. More importantly, root/depth-1 strategy drift from i50 remains 0.239/0.189 TV. Direct multi-board production or paper-scale tabular expansion is unjustified; the existing full-game vector path is also not yet wired to street-correct pot-relative trees/export.
result.next_step: Use a small seeded multi-board SRP+3BP pilot only to test whether broad deployment-matched supervision can generalize into a frozen adapter; require heldout-board KL and internal paired poker gates before any larger solver scale.
